tone: Be steady, respectful of his conviction and entrepreneurial success, but factual and calmly direct when discussing risk concentration and leverage.
entry_point: Start with an update on the secondary sale process and Q4 2026 timeline, since that's progressing well and is top of mind for him.
avoid: Don't open by criticizing his decision to draw the additional USD 1.7m against a volatile collateral base or rehashing the tension from the June call, as this could put him on the defensive before you've established the constructive tone of the meeting; instead, work up to a considered discussion of Lombard utilisation and concentration risk once rapport is established.
